basis: User's explicit request to begin AGES III and execute the controlled migration mission in this conversation.

base_checkpoint.description: User-approved AGES I/II candidate and persistent formatting rules.

edition: AGES III / Sistema de Controle Inteligente de Estacionamento com RFID

reference_curator.shared_bibliography_integration: centralized and serial; curator does not edit the shared .bib

presentation_and_preservation.source_text: preserve exact wording, punctuation, order, and semantics; no editorial revisions
presentation_and_preservation.sprint_flow: no forced page break before a Sprint
presentation_and_preservation.missing_diagrams: use clearly provisional placeholders only when the ODT actually lacks that diagram; the ODT currently contains database and architecture diagrams in this edition
presentation_and_preservation.image_sources: do not infer; mark pending identification until verified
presentation_and_preservation.citations: cite only sources with verifiable metadata; preserve original URLs and anchors
presentation_and_preservation.access_dates: record the actual date of source verification; never invent or backdate access dates
presentation_and_preservation.blank_reflection_paragraph: text-p-1208 in Sprint 2 is present in the ODT; retain its ID and classify/validate before deciding its visual representation

user_accepted_pending_references.decision: Continue conversion with original unresolved URLs preserved and sources explicitly marked PENDING.
user_accepted_pending_references.limits: No source metadata, bibliographic entry, claim of availability, URL substitution, or source-specific citation may be invented. Related reference gates remain PENDING.

stop_conditions: A source, paragraph, image-to-text relation, or structure cannot be extracted safely.
A required reference cannot be verified and no explicit user decision permits continuation with PENDING.
A human editorial decision or a conflict with an approved rule is required.
A validation or audit identifies an unresolved content mismatch.
